 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJNISH BHATNAGAR  ORDER % 18.12.2023 1.
This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C for quashing of FIR No.9/2021, under Section 420 IPC, registered at Police Station Vijay Vihar, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
Learned APP appears on advance notice, and accepts notice.
He seeks time to file the status report.

3. Let the status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
4. List on 8th April, 2024.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J DECEMBER 18, 2023/ib
